reviewScope: Authenticated binary and visual/copy QA for individual v3 PNG masters 13-18
releasePolicy: Historical evidence only. The six binaries recorded in this file remain rejected and must never be treated as the current learner binaries. Rebuilt production masters are separately governed by the current release manifest and registry.
commonFindings: All six authenticated v3 images are 384 × 512 px and therefore fail the production-resolution gate.
All six v3 images incorrectly label their location as Course 1 | Module 1. Lessons 13-15 belong to Module 5; lessons 16-18 belong to Module 6.
All six v3 images use Cultivation Technician Certification branding even though Course 1 public academic completion is separate from Technician I professional credential eligibility and issuance.

Each rebuilt image must preserve Technician I authorization boundaries and defer facility-specific actions to the current SOP, manufacturer instructions, controlled record system, or authorized role as applicable.
